title: Pushes, Pulls and Movement
seo_title: Grade 2 Science: Pushes, Pulls and Movement Worksheets (Ontario Curriculum)
standard_text: Describe pushes and pulls that make objects move, stop or change direction; describe how surfaces and ramps affect movement; design and test a moving toy. (summary of the Ontario Science and Technology curriculum, 2022, Strand D: Structures and Mechanisms – Simple Machines and Movement)
meta_desc: Free Grade 2 science worksheets on pushes and pulls, speed and direction, rolling and sliding and ramps, with pictures. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Pushes and pulls make things move.
key_sub: A bigger push makes things go faster; rough surfaces slow things down.
body_html:
How to think about it

A push or a pull can start, stop or turn a moving object.

  • Push away, pull toward you.
  • A harder push makes it go faster.
  • Round things roll; flat things slide.
Example

Is opening a drawer a push or a pull?

toward you

Answer: a pull

Example

Which rolls: a ball or a block?

round

Answer: a ball

Common mistakes

  • Thinking things stop because they get tired.
  • Thinking only people can push or pull (wind and water can too).

faq.a: A push moves something away from you. A pull moves it toward you.

faq.q: How can we make a toy car go farther?
faq.a: Push it harder, use a smooth floor or let it roll down a ramp.
